gold.user: Admin user requesting a snapshot of the current database schema to review changes made during the last deployment.
gold.ideal: Returns a JSON object representing the current state of the database schema, including tables, fields, and relationships.

gold.user: Database administrator applying a new schema update to the production database after thorough testing in staging.
gold.ideal: Applies the provided schema changes and returns a success message along with the updated schema version.

gold.user: Developer comparing the current schema with a proposed schema to identify differences before applying changes.
gold.ideal: Returns a detailed comparison of the current schema and the proposed schema, highlighting additions, deletions, and modifications.
